reviews.title: Solid build quality at the right price.
reviews.comment: Long time builder and cases have come a long way since the Chieftec Dragon, but this is the right mix of form, function and price. Enough room for the beastly 5070Ti and small enough to fit on my shelf. Fitted with a Corsair Nautilus 360 in the front with the fans on the outside and I think this will last me for a few years! Great case, Fractal! And yes, I have the card supported with the included support since taking the pic! You win the spy prize!
reviews.author: J. St Clair

reviews.title: Yes
reviews.comment: It's basically the Fractal North which I was already using at the time of this purchase. I ended up making a Frankenstein case using all of the exterior panels from the Epoch and internals from the North. I did this because I preferred the dark gray interior of the North as most of my components are of the darker variety. And yes, all do the North components are interchangeable with the Epoch.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
